programs.title: 3-Month Electronics Repair, Replacement & Maintenance Boot Camp
programs.summary: Hands-on training in electronics repair, replacement & maintenance. 90% practical, 3 months, up to 20 seats.
programs.description:
A practical, hands-on training designed for underprivileged youth (18–35 years) who are passionate about changing their situation, acquiring new skills, becoming entrepreneurs, and serving their communities.

TRAINING INCLUDES:
• Electronics Fundamentals
• Components Testing
• Soldering & Desoldering
• Board Level Repair
• Tools & Equipment Handling
• Business & Entrepreneurship

GRADUATES RECEIVE:
• Certificate of Completion
• Entrepreneurship Guidance
• Career Support
• Starter Kit (for outstanding trainees)

CURRICULUM:
• Laptop & Desktop Repair
• Mobile Phone Repair
• Electronic Troubleshooting
• Flat TV Repair

programs.title: NGO Staff & Volunteers — One Week Practical ICT Training
programs.summary: Stop struggling with everyday digital tasks. One-week hands-on ICT boot camp for NGO staff, volunteers, and field officers.
programs.description:
One-week practical ICT training designed for NGO staff, volunteers, field officers, program coordinators, and project teams working with digital tools.

PRACTICAL SKILLS YOU WILL LEARN:
• Microsoft Word — Reports & Letters
• Microsoft Excel — Data & Basic Formulas
• PowerPoint — Presentations that Inspire
• Email & Internet — Effective Communication
• Google Workspace — Docs, Sheets, Drive
• Data Management & File Organization
• Online Safety & Digital Best Practices
• Using AI Tools to Work Smarter

BONUS MODULES:
• Using WhatsApp Business for Communication
• Cloud Storage & Collaboration
• Digital Tools for Project Management
• Creating Forms & Surveys (Google Forms)
• Document Templates & Automation Tips

DURATION: One Week (5 Training Days)
FORMAT: Hands-on practical sessions, interactive, small class size

YOU WILL RECEIVE:
• Certificate of Participation
• Resources
• Ongoing Support

TIME: 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM
LOCATION: 5C BaiBureh Road, Ferry Junction, Freetown

resources.description: The curriculum is deliberately based on current Sierra Leone digital-skills priorities. posts.title: First cohort graduates 13 trainees
posts.body:
Our first Vocational Training Programme in Electronic Repairs and Maintenance has successfully completed with 13 trainees. Approximately 90% of the learning was practical — participants worked directly with broken equipment from the office, developing diagnostic and repair skills through supervised hands-on activities.

The practical examination, using real broken equipment, was a defining moment. Their performance was reported as extremely good, demonstrating the value of practice-based learning.

10 starter kits have already been secured for outstanding trainees. Graduates are expected to return to their communities and establish small electronics repair enterprises.

posts.title: New Training Center Opened in Freetown
posts.body:
We've relocated to a new apartment in a strategic location, providing:
• Better learning environment
• Increased accessibility
• Additional operational space
• Improved workshop capacity
• Expansion opportunities for future initiatives

The new facility now serves multiple functions: training center, refurbishment workspace, administrative office, and mentorship/meeting space.

posts.title: Phase Three: Electronics Shop & Refurbishment Center
posts.body:
We're entering our next major phase — the establishment of the Electronics Shop and Refurbishment Center. The shop will sell new and slightly used electronic equipment, while the refurbishment center will diagnose, repair, and restore faulty devices.

Together, they'll create an income-generating platform supporting our team, tools, utilities, future training, and enterprise development.

Our short-term ambition is to train up to 80 youths annually through multiple cycles.
